thread:
nina: During the weekend incident we kept seeing 'fallback' rows with no context. Can we make the console show the fallback policy + trigger_code inline?

omar: Yes. Minimal inline fields: policy_name, trigger_code, to_variant. Expandable for full event.

lei: Also need a stable short token (fb=<8c>) that appears in row and telemetry. That token should be usable in CLI to open event.

signals-bot: :information_source: feature-flag "rw.fallback.inline_token" scheduled for canary 2026-04-05.

nina: UX note: don't increase row height. Show small pill with policy and code. Click -> side panel with event link, operator notes, and model digests.

omar: Implementation: runtime emits compact header X-Rw-Fb when flag enabled for internal keys. Header carries id,policy,trigger,to. No prompt or content.

lei: Tests: e2e to ensure header only for internal keys, and UI test for expand/side-panel. Also perf test to measure header overhead.

nina: I'll write a short RFC with example header and console mock. Tagging @eng-sre and @eng-devex.

omar: I'll add decision_id generator to runtime. Use base36 hash of (trace_id|policy_v|minute).

lei: Good. Also add fallback counters by trigger for analytics.

signals-bot: :bell: telemetry keys added: fallback.count, fallback.latency_ms, tags: policy_name, trigger_code, decision_id.

nina: Thanks all. Small follow-up: include parent_decision_id for chained fallbacks.
